info.title: IM Services (Incident Management) API
info.description:
APIs for the E4H IM (Incident Management / Grievance Redressal) service. Covers incident/request lifecycle (create, search, plain-search, update, boundary-by-facility bulk update, migration updates, count, theft-notification trigger), a legacy v1-contract migration/transform endpoint, a user login report endpoint, video storage upload, and a set of mock/dev-only endpoints.

### Authentication
This service does not use a separate `Authorization` HTTP header scheme. Instead, every JSON request body is wrapped in a `RequestInfo` object (see the `RequestInfo` schema) whose `authToken` field carries the Bearer JWT/OAuth token, and whose `userInfo` field carries the caller's resolved identity (uuid, userName, roles, etc). The `authToken` is obtained beforehand via egov-user's `/user/oauth/token` (password/OTP grant) or `/user/_login` API. Downstream services (including this one) validate `RequestInfo.authToken` server-side; there is no separate bearer-token security scheme at the HTTP layer for these endpoints.

### Divergence note
This document reflects the controllers' actual, current behavior as implemented in code. Two legacy reference files in this repository (`src/main/resources/swagger-contract.yml` and `src/main/resources/contractForCodeGen.yml`) describe an older v1 PGR-style contract (`/requests/_search`, `/requests/_create`, `/requests/_update` without a version/mock prefix, using a `ServiceRequest`/`ServiceResponse`/`PGREntity` shape) that no longer matches the live `/v2/request/...` and `/mock/requests/...` endpoints implemented by the controllers. That legacy contract is not reconciled here; the controllers are treated as the source of truth.

Role.description: A role assigned to a user, scoped to a tenant.

UserInfo.description: Caller identity embedded in RequestInfo. Resolved server-side from the authToken/session by egov-user; at minimum uuid, userName and roles should be populated by the client.

User.description: im-services' own User representation (e.g. Incident.reporter, UserLoginReport UserRequest.User). Structurally identical to UserInfo plus an 'active' flag.

RequestInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT request header wrapping every JSON request body. authToken is the auth carrier: it holds the Bearer JWT/OAuth token obtained via egov-user's /user/oauth/token or /user/_login API. There is no separate Authorization HTTP header for these APIs; authentication happens via this field plus userInfo.

msgId.description: Unique request message id from the caller.

authToken.description: Bearer JWT/OAuth token issued by egov-user (/user/oauth/token or /user/_login). This IS the authentication mechanism for this service - there is no separate Authorization header.

ResponseInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT response header wrapping every JSON response body.

Error.description: A single error entry, as produced by egov-tracer's org.egov.tracer.model.Error for a CustomException.

description.example: A mandatory field was missing or invalid in the request.

ErrorRes.description: Standard eGov error response shape returned (HTTP 400 by default) by egov-tracer's handling of org.egov.tracer.model.CustomException thrown anywhere in the request-processing chain.

AuditDetails.description: Collection of audit related fields used by most models.

Document.description: A document attached during a workflow transition.

WarrantyStatus.description: Warranty status of the underlying installed asset (e.g. solar system).

Workflow.description: Workflow action/state-transition details submitted alongside an incident create/update.

action.description: Action on the application, e.g. APPLY, FORWARD, REJECT, RESOLVE, REOPEN.

Incident.description: Instance of an incident/service request raised for a particular service. "additionalDetail" carries the input values required by the metadata definition described by the corresponding MDMS schema. Any one of 'address' or '(lat and lng)' or 'addressId' is mandatory (validated in the service layer).

post.description: NOT A PRODUCTION API. Accepts the same RequestInfoWrapper body + search-criteria query params as the real /v2/request/_search, but ignores them entirely and returns the static contents of the bundled classpath:mockData.json file verbatim.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant/ULB identifier to search within. Mandatory for most search flows (enforced in service layer, not by @NotNull).

parameters.name: tenantIds
parameters.description: Search across multiple tenant identifiers.

parameters.name: serviceCode
parameters.description: Filter by one or more service codes.

parameters.name: applicationStatus
parameters.description: Filter by one or more application statuses (e.g. APPLIED, ASSIGNED, RESOLVED).

parameters.name: phcType
parameters.description: Filter by one or more facility (PHC) types.

parameters.name: phcSubType
parameters.description: Filter by one or more facility (PHC) sub-types.

parameters.name: mobileNumber
parameters.description: Filter by reporter mobile number.

parameters.name: boundaryCode
parameters.description: Filter by boundary code.

parameters.name: systemFunctional
parameters.description: Filter by system-functional status.

parameters.name: incidentId
parameters.description: Filter by a single formatted incident id.

parameters.name: incidentType
parameters.description: Filter by one or more incident types.

parameters.name: incidentSubType
parameters.description: Filter by one or more incident sub-types.

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: Filter by district.

parameters.name: block
parameters.description: Filter by block.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort results by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: locality
parameters.description: Filter by one or more localities.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Filter by one or more internal incident UUIDs.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Lower bound (epoch millis) on filed/created date. Requires toDate if used, per validation.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Upper bound (epoch millis) on filed/created date.

parameters.name: slaDeltaMaxLimit
parameters.description: Upper bound on SLA delta (ms).

parameters.name: slaDeltaMinLimit
parameters.description: Lower bound on SLA delta (ms).

parameters.name: filedDateThresholdMs
parameters.description: When set, only incidents where (currentTime - COALESCE(filedDate, createdTime)) >= this value (ms) are returned. Used e.g. for theft-notification threshold scans. Must not be negative.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Page offset.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Filter by reporter account id.

post.summary: [MOCK/DEV ONLY] Look up HRMS departments for users
post.description: NOT A PRODUCTION API / diagnostic endpoint. Unlike the other /mock endpoints this one performs a REAL live call: looks up the HRMS department for each given user uuid via HRMSUtil, using the RequestInfo from the request body for authentication to the HRMS service.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant id to scope the HRMS lookup.

parameters.name: uuids
parameters.description: One or more employee uuids to resolve department names for.

200.description: Department names, one per input uuid (order corresponds to HRMS resolution, not guaranteed to match input order).

400.description: Bad request - validation failure or business-rule violation. Returned by egov-tracer's default handling of org.egov.tracer.model.CustomException thrown by the service layer (HTTP 400).

Errors.message: The Department of the user with uuid: [...] is not found
Errors.description: HRMS did not return department info for one or more of the given uuids.

Errors.description: The requesting user's role is not authorized for this operation.
